# /etc/systemd/system/cloud9-zfs-rehab-collector.timer
[Unit]
Description=Refresh cloud_arezki ZFS rehabilitation dashboard every 5 seconds

[Timer]
OnBootSec=8s
OnUnitActiveSec=5s
AccuracySec=1s
Unit=cloud9-zfs-rehab-collector.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target

# /etc/systemd/system/cloud9-zfs-rehab-collector.timer.d/90-cloud9-minimize-io.conf
[Timer]
OnUnitActiveSec=
OnUnitActiveSec=120s
AccuracySec=12s
why: Completed one-time ZFS recovery and 4 cloud uploads; polling zpool, smartctl and kernel journal every120sec now redundant
rollback: systemctl enable --now cloud9-zfs-rehab-collector.timer only if a new scrub/rehab project starts
